prompt:
Tripod shot, the camera completely still, at night on the riverside walk under the lit bridge. The woman in the camel cardigan already has her right arm raised high with the phone. She snaps that arm forward once and lets go: the single phone sails out past the railing and drops into the dark river. Then her right hand hangs open and empty. Her left hand keeps holding the same one wine glass, low at her side, the whole time. She stays on the spot and yells after it. Her friend in the olive jacket laughs with her own one glass. The railing, the walkway, the benches, the bridge and the skyline are fixed scenery and never move or shift; only the two women and the phone move. Sound: river lapping, wind, a shout. No music.

Thanks.
